title: Chocolate Orange Fudgy Squares
description: Fudgy chocolate orange traybake squares made with blended black beans instead of flour, topped with chunks of milk chocolate.
ingredients: 400g can black beans, drained and rinsed
50g milk chocolate, chopped into small chunks
steps: In a food processor, whizz beans, eggs, yogurt, vanilla extract, maple syrup and sugar until smooth.
Add orange zest, cocoa powder, salt and baking powder; whizz again until thoroughly mixed.
Line a 20cm square cake tin with parchment; spray with cooking spray.
Pour in mixture; scatter chocolate chunks over top.
Bake on middle shelf 15 minutes. Check with a knife — if still liquid, bake 5 more minutes.
Cut into 16 squares; enjoy warm or cold. Store in fridge up to 5 days.
notes: Freeze in an airtight container up to 3 months. Defrost at room temperature.
source: The Slimming Foodie by Pip Payne (2021, Aster/Octopus)
